children: Cathie Wood moved investments into Nvidia and Broadcom, with Ark Invest's largest transaction last week being semiconductor manufacturer Advanced Micro Devices Inc. (AMD, Financials).

Ark sold an estimated $95 million of 201,863 shares of AMD. The company also purchased 243,707 shares of Nvidia, valued at about $53 million, and 112,836 shares of Broadcom, valued at around $41 million.
That gives Ark's Nvidia and Broadcom buys a total close to $94 million, nearly wiping out the amount it cut from AMD. The trades represent a major change in Ark's exposure to semiconductors.

Nvidia is the primary supplier of AI accelerators, but Broadcom has emerged as a big winner because to the need for networking and specialized AI chips. AMD remains a key adversary, but Ark's new steps reflect where Ms. Wood is putting more of her money these days.
Ark purchased nearly $30 million of Cerebras Systems and $13.6 million of Cloudflare, adding to the week's concentration on AI infrastructure.
For investors, the question now is whether this rotation continues as expectations rise ever higher for Nvidia and Broadcom while AMD tries to close the gap on AI computing.

title: Cathie Wood Just Swapped $95 Million of AMD for Nvidia and Broadcom
